string-mode-expansion-a601d45d.title: String Mode Expansion
string-mode-expansion-a601d45d.interpretation: String Mode Expansion: The fundamental rule decomposing the string position into center-of-mass motion and an infinite tower of quantum harmonic oscillators.
string-mode-expansion-a601d45d.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

approximate-truth-limit-074a55f7.title: Approximate Truth Limit
approximate-truth-limit-074a55f7.interpretation: The formal realist assertion that successive scientific theories converge asymptotically upon the true ontological structure of the universe.

canonical-stress-energy-tensor-e6b3edc9.title: Canonical Stress-Energy Tensor
canonical-stress-energy-tensor-e6b3edc9.interpretation: Identifies the conserved four-current densities associated with the spacetime translation invariance of the field Lagrangian.
canonical-stress-energy-tensor-e6b3edc9.symmetry_origin: Noether's theorem applied to the external symmetries of the 4D manifold.
canonical-stress-energy-tensor-e6b3edc9.limits_and_boundary: Encapsulates the density and flux of energy and momentum within the subatomic vacuum.

schwarzschild-stability-criterion-ident-.title: Schwarzschild Stability Criterion
schwarzschild-stability-criterion-ident-.interpretation: States that a stellar layer is stable against convection if the temperature gradient required to move energy by radiation is less than the adiabatic gradient.
schwarzschild-stability-criterion-ident-.symmetry_origin: The buoyancy condition (Archimedes' principle) applied to a stratified compressible fluid.
schwarzschild-stability-criterion-ident-.limits_and_boundary: When this inequality is reversed, the layer becomes superadiabatic and turbulent convection initiates.

quantum-potential-energy-ident-00988cf6.title: The Quantum Potential (Q)
quantum-potential-energy-ident-00988cf6.interpretation: Represents an additional 'Potential Energy' term that accounts for all quantum effects in the Bohmian Hamilton-Jacobi equation, where R is the amplitude of the wave function.
quantum-potential-energy-ident-00988cf6.symmetry_origin: The identification of the 'Non-Classical' rungs of the subatomic vacuum through the separation of phase and amplitude.
quantum-potential-energy-ident-00988cf6.limits_and_boundary: In the limit where Q vanishes, the system identically reproduces the rays of classical Newtonian mechanics.

scale-factor-power-law-evolution-ident-2.title: Scale Factor Power Law
scale-factor-power-law-evolution-ident-2.interpretation: Describes the temporal growth of the universal scale factor a(t) for a flat universe dominated by a component with equation of state w, selectioning the specific expansion rate of the manifold.
scale-factor-power-law-evolution-ident-2.symmetry_origin: The integration of the Friedmann equations under the assumption of power-law density depletion.
scale-factor-power-law-evolution-ident-2.limits_and_boundary: Unifies the expansion histories of radiation (t^1/2), matter (t^2/3), and curvature (t^1) dominated epochs.

qft-qed-lagrangian-f42f7650.title: Gauge Invariant QED Lagrangian
qft-qed-lagrangian-f42f7650.interpretation: Establishes the fundamental Lagrangian density for Quantum Electrodynamics, coupling a Dirac spinor field to a vector gauge field via the gauge covariant derivative.
qft-qed-lagrangian-f42f7650.symmetry_origin: Originates from local U(1) gauge symmetry, which mandates the coupling between the electron field and the electromagnetic vector potential to preserve phase invariance.
qft-qed-lagrangian-f42f7650.limits_and_boundary: Reduces to the free Dirac and free Maxwell Lagrangian densities in the limit where the coupling constant approaches zero (non-interacting limit).
